The '''Veragi system''' was located in the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]], a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Veragi Trade Route/Legends|Veragi Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected it to the [[Trassitan system/Legends|Trassitan system]] as well as the [[Julevian system]] of the neighboring [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]]. Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked the Veragi [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the [[Plesstil system/Legends|Plesstil system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Ghost ship|starship]] known as the [[Ghost Ship of Veragi]].<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Specter in Space}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Veragi system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-3.<ref name="TEA" />
